what: A color band at the screen edge. Color segments of varied lengths from 78 to 543px (neighbors differ in color) join up, segment thickness ripples between 2 and 10px nonstop with a three-layer sine wave, and the whole band drifts slowly at .02px/ms. The vertical band is attached to the document, so it scrolls past with the page, while the horizontal band (segments 1/4 the length · .015px/ms) flows sideways in place. Motion off (html[data-motion-enabled=false]) or reduced motion stops it at that shape

options.colors: Color variable names separated by commas — defaults --kf-accent, --kf-warning, --kf-success, --kf-danger, --kf-accent-soft, --kf-ink-soft. The brand skin uses six branch colors.
options.drift: Flow speed (px/ms), default .02 (.015 for horizontal). 0 means no flow, only ripples
options.seg-min: Minimum segment length (px), default 78 (1/4 for landscape)
options.seg-max: Max segment length (px), default 543 (1/4 of the width in landscape)
options.scroll: If on, the band pattern attaches to the document position — vertical default on, horizontal default off
options.flip: If on, thickness grows from the opposite edge (right end band·bottom band)

note: The original is an Astro site’s canvas script — rewritten with the same values. Colors are read from variables on attach and on resize, not on every paint

from.where: shared.js vertical strips at the left and right screen edges, horizontal strip as the closing band (original WaveRail · data-wave-rail-orientation)
